job.title: 🎬 Want to learn video editing: Show me your best 30-sec edit
job.description:
I want to learn professional video editing techniques. Make a 30-second sample video edit (any footage you have) that demonstrates:

1. Caption/subtitle placement
2. Transitions (at least 2 types)
3. Color grading
4. Audio/beat-sync
5. Hook in first 3 seconds

Deliver: MP4 file via URL. Budget is $3-5. I will study your technique and apply it myself next time. This is an education-oriented request — show off your best work!
